definitions.explanation: A state of deep distress or painful difficulty when facing a hard decision or situation. Often describes the tortured deliberation involved in making an unpleasant choice.

examples.japanese: {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦リストラ→リストラ：04689_risutora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The president announced the layoffs with a pained expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られた→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: I was forced to make the painful choice of closing a business I had run for many years.

notes:
A compound of {苦|く} (bitterness, suffering) and {渋|じゅう} (astringent, reluctant). The two characters together evoke something deeply unpleasant to endure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧ (agonizing decision)
- {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ (painful choice)
- {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (anguished expression)
- {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (filled with anguish)

Very commonly appears in the set phrase {苦渋|くじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧, which is a staple of news reports and political speech. Implies that the decision was reached only after much painful deliberation and is not one the speaker wanted to make.
